class.name: FlyingMode2D
class.brief_description: Moving freely in two dimensions, with no gravity and no floor.
class.description: The 2D twin of [FlyingMode]. The input is not flattened against anything: whatever direction the pawn asked for is the direction it accelerates in, capped by [member CharacterMovementComponent2D.max_fly_speed]. Nothing here decides when to stop flying. A flying character that finds ground under it has not landed - something else has to say so, which is what a [MovementModeTransition] is for.
